## Generating logs

Prefer SITL over real flights, so the corpus is reproducible and carries no
location history.

```sh
# PX4
make px4_sitl gazebo-classic     # logs land in build/px4_sitl_default/rootfs/log/

# ArduPilot
sim_vehicle.py -v ArduCopter --console --map
```

Truncated fixtures are made by copying a good log and cutting it short:

```sh
head -c 40000 good.ulg > truncated.ulg
```
